title: Complete typed relationship schema and validation contract
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that runtime MemoryRecord/MemoryRelationshipEdge supports typed Relationships, RelationType, and EdgeOrigin, while Schemas/memory.schema.json documents only legacy References/Conflicts and permits extra properties. Schema-driven clients cannot validate the typed graph contract. Evidence: MemorySmith.Core/Models/MemoryRecord.cs, MemoryRelationshipEdge.cs, Schemas/memory.schema.json. Add typed-edge shapes/enums and executable schema-parity validation.
